data.name: VoidFall
data.detailed_description:
Dive into Voidfall, a cooperative multiplayer action game where you must survive increasingly powerful waves of monsters.

Face relentless hordes of enemies, upgrade your character, and adapt your playstyle to last as long as possible in intense and dynamic battles.

Experience fast-paced action where every second matters.

Dodge, attack, and survive against ever more dangerous waves of enemies.

Team up with your friends or other players online to survive together.

Cooperation is essential to push back the waves and go further.

Develop your character over time through each run:

stat upgrades

increased damage

improved speed, survivability, and efficiency

playstyle optimization

Every run makes you stronger.

Enemies arrive in continuous waves.

The longer you survive, the harder the challenge becomes.

Adapt your strategies and hold out as long as possible.

Cooperative multiplayer action gameplay

Wave-based survival system

Character progression system

Fast and dynamic combat

Skill and coordination-based gameplay

Online multiplayer experience

Only the most coordinated and reactive players will survive the most advanced waves.

Download Voidfall and enter the arena.
